card.name: Andvari (The Mole)
card.power: Asset Freeze: Target player cannot draw cards next turn. They are auditing their hoard.
card.lore: He sat on the gold until Loki squeezed him like a stress ball. It's not hoarding if you're underground.

line: Andvari, Asset Freeze: auditing hoard; Loki squeezed him like stress ball.
spokenText: Andvari, Asset Freeze: auditing hoard; Loki squeezed him like stress ball.

card.name: Loki (The Fox)
card.power: Forced Liquidation: Steal one Item card from an opponent. If they complain, steal another.
card.lore: He caught the pike, killed the otter, and bullied the dwarf. Basically, a standard consultant.

line: Loki, Forced Liquidation: steal Item; pike, otter, dwarf, standard consultant.
spokenText: Remember Loki, Forced Liquidation: steal Item; pike, otter, dwarf, standard consultant.

card.name: The Ring (The Loop)
card.power: Compound Interest: The holder gains +2 Attack but must discard a card every turn. The debt always wins.
card.lore: Andvaranaut. It breeds gold, but it eats owners. The ultimate pyramid scheme.

line: The Ring, Compound Interest: gold breeds, eats owners; debt always wins.
spokenText: The Ring, Compound Interest: gold breeds, eats owners; debt always wins.

card.name: The Curse (The Fine Print)
card.power: Bad Ending: Attach to a Hero Card. That Hero dies at the end of the round. No saves.
card.lore: Death to the owner. Joy to no one. Until the gold returns to the water, everyone is just renting their life.

line: The Curse, Bad Ending: Hero dies; death to owner, everyone renting life.
spokenText: The Curse, Bad Ending: Hero dies; death to owner, everyone renting life.

card.name: Siegfried (The Retriever)
card.power: Main Character Syndrome: You cannot lose a duel unless the opponent rolls a natural 6.
card.lore: Strong enough to kill a dragon. Dumb enough to not check his back for leaves. The ultimate Himbo.

line: Siegfried, Main Character Syndrome: kill dragon, not check back for leaves.
spokenText: You know Siegfried, Main Character Syndrome: kill dragon, not check back for leaves.

card.name: Dragon Blood (The Juice)
card.power: Thick Skin: Ignore all damage from non-magical weapons. You smell like sulfur and ego.
card.lore: Bathe in the blood of your enemies. It's great for the pores and makes you legally invincible.

line: Dragon Blood, Thick Skin: ignore damage; sulfur and ego, legally invincible.
spokenText: Dragon Blood, Thick Skin: ignore damage; sulfur and ego, legally invincible.

card.name: The Linden Leaf (The Target)
card.power: Critical Fail: Play on an opponent's Siegfried. Their Defense drops to 0.
card.lore: One tiny leaf. One giant design flaw. Proof that nature hates perfection.

line: The Linden Leaf, Critical Fail: one tiny leaf, one giant design flaw.
spokenText: The Linden Leaf, Critical Fail: one tiny leaf, one giant design flaw.

card.name: Balmung (The Problem Solver)
card.power: Overkill: +4 Attack. If you win, destroy the opponent's weapon card too.
card.lore: Subtlety is for people who can't cleave an anvil in half.

line: Balmung, Overkill, destroys opponent's weapon too? Cleave anvil in half.
spokenText: What if Balmung, Overkill, destroys opponent's weapon too? Cleave anvil in half.

card.name: Gunther (The Sheep)
card.power: Delegate Authority: When challenged, force another player to fight for you.
card.lore: King of Burgundy. Brave leader, as long as someone else is doing the fighting, wooing, and thinking.

line: Gunther, Delegate Authority: brave, as long as someone else is fighting.
spokenText: Gunther, Delegate Authority: brave, as long as someone else is fighting.

card.name: Tarnkappe (The Ghost Mode)
card.power: Assist Mode: Add Siegfried's Attack stats to Gunther's roll. Invisible cheating is still cheating.
card.lore: Invisibility cloak. Great for wrestling women who are stronger than you without them knowing. Creepy.

line: Tarnkappe, Assist Mode: invisible cheating; wrestling women stronger than you.
spokenText: Tarnkappe, Assist Mode: invisible cheating; wrestling women stronger than you.

card.name: The Proxy Wooing (Catfishing)
card.power: Identity Theft: Swap hand cards with another player. Claim it was a misunderstanding.
card.lore: He stands there, she fights him. He takes the credit. The original deepfake technology.

line: The Proxy Wooing, Identity Theft: swap hands, claim misunderstanding
spokenText: Anyway, The Proxy Wooing, Identity Theft: swap hands, claim misunderstanding

card.name: The Boat to Iceland
card.power: Travel Montage: Skip a turn to draw 3 cards.
card.lore: A long voyage to find a woman who can kill you with a pebble. Men are idiots.

line: The Boat to Iceland, Travel Montage: woman who can kill you with pebble. Men are idiots.
spokenText: The Boat to Iceland, Travel Montage: woman who can kill you with pebble. Men are idiots.

card.name: Brunhild (The Polar Bear)
card.power: Gatekeeper: Challenge an incoming player. If they lose, they are eliminated from the game.
card.lore: Queen of Iceland. Throws boulders for fun. Virginity is her power source (allegedly).

line: Brunhild, Gatekeeper: challenge incoming player; Queen throws boulders for fun.
spokenText: Brunhild, Gatekeeper: challenge incoming player; Queen throws boulders for fun.

card.name: The Boulder Throw
card.power: Heavy Artillery: Deal 5 damage. If the target is 'Gunther', deal 10.
card.lore: If you can't lift this, don't ask for her number.

line: The Boulder Throw, Heavy Artillery: can't lift this, don't ask for her number.
spokenText: No wait, The Boulder Throw, Heavy Artillery: can't lift this, don't ask for her number.

card.name: The Spear Toss
card.power: Shield Breaker: Ignore opponent's Defense stats this turn.
card.lore: It went through the shield, the armor, and the ego. Gunther fainted watching it.

line: The Spear Toss, Shield Breaker: shield, armor, ego; Gunther fainted.
spokenText: The Spear Toss, Shield Breaker: shield, armor, ego; Gunther fainted.

card.name: The Wall-Hook (Suspension)
card.power: Time Out: Suspend an opponent's Hero card for one round. They cannot act.
card.lore: She tied the King up and hung him on the wall until morning. The most honest interaction in the whole saga.

line: The Wall-Hook, Time Out: Hero cannot act; King hung on wall until morning.
spokenText: The Wall-Hook, Time Out: Hero cannot act; King hung on wall until morning.

card.name: The Wrestling Match
card.power: Tag Team: Play this card to double your Attack for one turn, then lose 2 Health.
card.lore: The lights went out, and the 'King' suddenly got very strong. Kayfabe at its finest.

line: The Wrestling Match, Tag Team: lights out, King very strong. Kayfabe.
spokenText: Before we continue, The Wrestling Match, Tag Team: lights out, King very strong. Kayfabe.

card.name: The Girdle (The Belt)
card.power: Disempower: Target loses all special abilities. Without the belt, the magic is gone.
card.lore: Siegfried stole it as a souvenir. Proof of conquest. Also, proof of being a terrible brother-in-law.

line: The Girdle, Disempower: Siegfried's souvenir; terrible brother-in-law.
spokenText: The Girdle, Disempower: Siegfried's souvenir; terrible brother-in-law.

card.name: The Ring of Tears
card.power: Evidence: Reveal this card to start a war between two players.
card.lore: He gave the other woman's ring to his wife. Rookie mistake. Tactical suicide.

line: The Ring of Tears, Evidence: ring starts war; Rookie mistake, tactical suicide.
spokenText: The Ring of Tears, Evidence: ring starts war; Rookie mistake, tactical suicide.

card.name: The Submission
card.power: Depower: Change Brunhild's stats to 1/1/1.
card.lore: Once she lost her virginity, she lost her strength. Ancient writers really didn't understand how women work.

line: The Submission, Depower: lost virginity, lost strength; ancient writers didn't understand women.
spokenText: Not a metaphor: The Submission, Depower: lost virginity, lost strength; ancient writers didn't understand women.

card.name: Hagen (The Badger)
card.power: Pragmatism: Cancel any 'Magic' or 'Lore' effect played against you. Reality checks hurt.
card.lore: He's not a villain. He's the only guy in the story who actually does his job. Digs holes, buries bodies.

line: Hagen, Pragmatism: cancel Magic or Lore; buries bodies, does his job.
spokenText: Hagen, Pragmatism: cancel Magic or Lore; buries bodies, does his job.

card.name: The Cross on the Robe
card.power: Marked for Death: Attach to Siegfried. Attacks against him gain +5 Damage.
card.lore: Kriemhild sewed it on to 'protect' him. Hagen used it as a bullseye. Loose lips sink ships.

line: The Cross on the Robe, Marked for Death: sewed on to protect, used as bullseye.
spokenText: The Cross on the Robe, Marked for Death: sewed on to protect, used as bullseye.

card.name: The False War Alarm
card.power: Distraction: Force opponents to tap out/rest their strongest card for a turn.
card.lore: A fake invasion to get the hero out of the house. The oldest trick in the book.

line: The False War Alarm, Distraction: fake invasion, hero out of house
spokenText: The thing about The False War Alarm, Distraction: fake invasion, hero out of house

card.name: The Spring (The Water Cooler)
card.power: Ambush Location: +3 Attack if played in a 'Forest' biome.
card.lore: We're just going for a run. Take a drink. Don't worry about your weapon. Or your back.

line: The Spring, Ambush Location: Forest; drink at spring, don't worry about back.
spokenText: The Spring, Ambush Location: Forest; drink at spring, don't worry about back.

card.name: The Spear in the Back
card.power: Assassination: Destroy a Hero card that has 'The Cross on the Robe' attached.
card.lore: A coward's blow? Maybe. But it worked. Honor is for dead people.

line: The Spear in the Back, Assassination: honor is for dead people.
spokenText: The Spear in the Back, Assassination: honor is for dead people.

card.name: The Corpse at the Door
card.power: Trauma: Target opponent must discard their hand due to grief.
card.lore: Hagen had him dumped right at Kriemhild's door. That's not just murder; that's sending a message.

line: The Corpse at the Door, Trauma: discard hand due grief; corpse dumped at door.
spokenText: Everyone agrees: The Corpse at the Door, Trauma: discard hand due grief; corpse dumped at door.

card.name: The Grief (Screaming Poodle)
card.power: Vengeance Oath: Gain a 'Grudge' token. Each token adds +1 Attack in future rounds.
card.lore: The cry woke the whole castle. A poodle scorned is a demon born.

line: The Grief, Vengeance Oath: Grudge tokens; poodle scorned, demon born.
spokenText: The Grief, Vengeance Oath: Grudge tokens; poodle scorned, demon born.

card.name: The Cover-Up
card.power: Denial: Negate a 'Truth' card.
card.lore: It was robbers. In the woods. Very tragic. Now, let's talk about inheritance.

line: The Cover-Up, Denial: negate Truth; robbers in woods, talk inheritance.
spokenText: The Cover-Up, Denial: negate Truth; robbers in woods, talk inheritance.

card.name: The Treasure Pile
card.power: Bribery: Pay 5 Gold to cancel an attack.
card.lore: Enough wealth to buy an army. Or destroy a kingdom. Kriemhild was using it to buy friends.

line: The Treasure Pile, Bribery? Pay gold, cancel attack; wealth buys friends.
spokenText: Have you heard of The Treasure Pile, Bribery? Pay gold, cancel attack; wealth buys friends.

card.name: The Rhine River
card.power: The Vault: Remove all 'Treasure' cards from play. No one gets them.
card.lore: Hagen sank it all. If he couldn't have it, nobody could. The ultimate gatekeeping.

line: The Rhine River, The Vault: Treasure removed; Hagen sank all, nobody gets them.
spokenText: The Rhine River, The Vault: Treasure removed; Hagen sank all, nobody gets them.

card.name: The Empty Hole
card.power: Economic Crash: All players lose 50% of their points.
card.lore: Where is the gold? Ask the fish. The first major liquidity crisis in German history.

line: The Empty Hole, Economic Crash: Where is gold? Ask fish; liquidity crisis.
spokenText: The Empty Hole, Economic Crash: Where is gold? Ask fish; liquidity crisis.

card.name: Oath of Silence
card.power: Omerta: You cannot be forced to reveal your hand.
card.lore: As long as one of us lives, the gold remains hidden. Spite is a powerful glue.

line: Oath of Silence, Omerta: hand hidden; gold remains hidden, spite powerful glue.
spokenText: Let me tell you about Oath of Silence, Omerta: hand hidden; gold remains hidden, spite powerful glue.

card.name: Etzel (The Ox)
card.power: Horde Command: Summon 3 'Hun' tokens (1/1/1) to fight for you.
card.lore: Attila. Mighty King. Scourge of God. Doesn't realize he's just a weapon in his new wife's purse.

line: Etzel, Horde Command: Hun tokens; King weapon in wife's purse.
spokenText: Etzel, Horde Command: Hun tokens; King weapon in wife's purse.

card.name: The Invitation
card.power: Force an opponent to move their pieces to a 'Trap' location.
card.lore: Come for the solstice. Stay for the massacre. Hagen knew it was a trap, but honor is stupid.

line: The Invitation, Trap Location: solstice invitation, stay for massacre.
spokenText: The Invitation, Trap Location: solstice invitation, stay for massacre.

card.name: The Journey East
card.power: Point of No Return: Once played, you cannot retreat. Fight or die.
card.lore: They crossed the Danube and smashed the boat. One way ticket to hell.

line: The Journey East, Point of No Return: no retreat; Danube crossed, boat smashed.
spokenText: This one has a rule: The Journey East, Point of No Return: no retreat; Danube crossed, boat smashed.

card.name: The Prophecy (Mermaids)
card.power: Spoiler Alert: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck. Keep the worst one.
card.lore: Only the chaplain returns alive. Everyone else is meat. Hagen tried to drown the chaplain to prove them wrong. He failed.

line: The Prophecy, Spoiler Alert: worst card; chaplain returns, everyone else meat.
spokenText: The Prophecy, Spoiler Alert: worst card; chaplain returns, everyone else meat.

card.name: The Banquet Table
card.power: Tension: No attacks this turn, but double damage next turn.
card.lore: Eat with your helmet on. Drink with your left hand. Don't mention the gold.

line: The Banquet Table, Tension: no attacks, next double damage; helmet at table.
spokenText: The Banquet Table, Tension: no attacks, next double damage; helmet at table.

card.name: Volker (The Mantis)
card.power: Violent Music: Your attacks count as 'Art'. Ignore armor.
card.lore: The Fiddler. He plays a tune that makes you want to dance, then cuts your head off. The bard of the apocalypse.

line: Volker, Violent Music: attacks Art, ignore armor; dance then head off.
spokenText: Nobody warned us about Volker, Violent Music: attacks Art, ignore armor; dance then head off.

card.name: The Severed Head (Appetizer)
card.power: First Blood: Start the combat phase immediately.
card.lore: Hagen chopped the kid's head off into the queen's lap. The diplomatic talks have concluded.

line: The Severed Head, First Blood: combat immediately; kid's head in queen's lap.
spokenText: The Severed Head, First Blood: combat immediately; kid's head in queen's lap.

card.name: The Barred Doors
card.power: Lockdown: No one leaves the room. The round ends when only one player remains.
card.lore: You're not locked in to fight them. You're locked in with them. The suffering begins.

line: The Barred Doors, Lockdown: no one leaves, suffering begins.
spokenText: The Barred Doors, Lockdown: no one leaves, suffering begins.

card.name: The Burning Roof
card.power: Environment Damage: Deal 1 damage to every player at the start of every turn.
card.lore: Kriemhild set the hall on fire. She's really committed to this revenge thing.

line: The Burning Roof, Environment Damage: really committed to this revenge thing.
spokenText: The deck insists on The Burning Roof, Environment Damage: really committed to this revenge thing.

card.name: The Thirst (Blood Wine)
card.power: Desperate Measure: Heal full health by drinking the blood of fallen minions.
card.lore: "Drink the blood," said Hagen. "It's better than wine." A literal quote. These people are insane.

line: The Thirst, Desperate Measure: heal by drinking blood; better than wine.
spokenText: The Thirst, Desperate Measure: heal by drinking blood; better than wine.

card.name: The Shield-Wall
card.power: Bunker: Invulnerable to fire damage for 2 turns.
card.lore: Stand by the wall. Let the roof fall in the middle. Tactical positioning in an oven.

line: The Shield-Wall, Bunker: invulnerable to fire; tactical positioning in oven.
spokenText: The Shield-Wall, Bunker: invulnerable to fire; tactical positioning in oven.

card.name: Staircase of Bodies
card.power: High Ground: +2 Defense. You are standing on your mistakes.
card.lore: They threw 7,000 bodies down the stairs. Cleaning service is going to quit.

line: Staircase of Bodies, High Ground: standing on mistakes; bodies down stairs.
spokenText: Which brings us to Staircase of Bodies, High Ground: standing on mistakes; bodies down stairs.

card.name: Dietrich von Bern (The Lion)
card.power: The Reluctant Hero: Starts passive. If attacked, destroys the attacker instantly.
card.lore: He didn't want to fight. But then you killed all his friends. Now the Lion is awake.

line: Dietrich von Bern, The Reluctant Hero: attacked, destroys attacker; Lion awake.
spokenText: Dietrich von Bern, The Reluctant Hero: attacked, destroys attacker; Lion awake.

card.name: Hildebrand (The Old Wolf)
card.power: Veteran Instinct: Reroll any failed die.
card.lore: Master of arms. Too old for this nonsense, but too loyal to leave.

line: Hildebrand, Veteran Instinct: reroll failed die; too old, too loyal.
spokenText: Hildebrand, Veteran Instinct: reroll failed die; too old, too loyal.

card.name: Rüdiger (The Dog)
card.power: Moral Conflict: Choose: Fight and die, or Refuse and die.
card.lore: The tragic hero. Forced to fight his friends because he promised a woman a favor. Be careful what you promise.

line: Rüdiger, Moral Conflict? Fight and die or refuse and die; promise a favor.
spokenText: Do you know Rüdiger, Moral Conflict? Fight and die or refuse and die; promise a favor.

card.name: The Dungeon
card.power: Capture: The game ends for these characters. Move to execution phase.
card.lore: Captured by Dietrich. Tied up. The fighting is over. The suffering begins.

line: The Dungeon, Capture: execution phase; fighting over, suffering begins.
spokenText: The Dungeon, Capture: execution phase; fighting over, suffering begins.

card.name: Gunther's Head
card.power: Proof: Discard this card to force Hagen to speak. (Spoiler: He won't.)
card.lore: She cut off her brother's head to make a point. The point being: She has lost her mind.

line: Gunther's Head, Proof: force Hagen to speak; he won't, brother's head cut off.
spokenText: Gunther's Head, Proof: force Hagen to speak; he won't, brother's head cut off.

card.name: Balmung Reclaimed
card.power: Execution: Kill a defenseless prisoner. Gain no Honor.
card.lore: She took the sword from Hagen. The sword her husband owned. Poetic justice, written in blood.

line: Balmung Reclaimed, Execution? Defenseless prisoner; poetic justice, written in blood.
spokenText: Did you hear of Balmung Reclaimed, Execution? Defenseless prisoner; poetic justice, written in blood.

card.name: Hagen's Laugh
card.power: Last Word: Even if you lose, the opponent gets 0 points for the victory.
card.lore: Now Gunther is dead, and I am the only one who knows where the gold is. And I'm taking it to hell. You lose.

line: Hagen's Laugh, Last Word: taking gold to hell. You lose.
spokenText: Hagen's Laugh, Last Word: taking gold to hell. You lose.

card.name: The Mastercut
card.power: Sudden Death: Eliminate the winner of the previous duel.
card.lore: Hildebrand couldn't watch a hero like Hagen die by a woman's hand. So he hacked Kriemhild to pieces. Chivalry is weird.

line: The Mastercut, Sudden Death: eliminate winner; Chivalry is weird.
spokenText: The Mastercut, Sudden Death: eliminate winner; Chivalry is weird.

card.name: The Survivors
card.power: Mourning: Skip 3 turns. Contemplate existence.
card.lore: King Etzel and Dietrich wept. For friends and foes. A lot of crying for a heavy metal album cover.

line: The Survivors, Mourning: lot of crying for heavy metal album cover.
spokenText: Welcome to The Survivors, Mourning: lot of crying for heavy metal album cover.

card.name: The Moral (There Isn't One)
card.power: Nullify: Cancel the entire game. No one wins.
card.lore: What did we learn? Don't steal gold. Don't trust badgers. And family reunions suck.

line: The Moral, Nullify: no one wins; don't steal gold, don't trust badgers.
spokenText: The Moral, Nullify: no one wins; don't steal gold, don't trust badgers.

card.name: The Reset Button
card.power: New Game: Shuffle all cards and start over. Maybe this time Siegfried wears back armor.
card.lore: The Nibelungen Not (Distress). It never ends. It just reboots.

line: The Reset Button, New Game: shuffle and start over; never ends, reboots.
spokenText: The Reset Button, New Game: shuffle and start over; never ends, reboots.

card.name: Uncle FrizzleBob (The Author)
card.power: Rule Breaker: Change one rule of the game permanently.
card.lore: I cut this up so you could play with corpses. Don't look at me like that. You bought the expansion.

line: Uncle FrizzleBob, Rule Breaker: play with corpses; you bought expansion.
spokenText: Meanwhile elsewhere, Uncle FrizzleBob, Rule Breaker: play with corpses; you bought expansion.

card.name: Toxic Masculinity
card.power: Ego Boost: +5 Attack, but you cannot retreat or heal. Ever.
card.lore: The driving force of the entire plot. If anyone had just gone to therapy, thousands would be alive.

line: Toxic Masculinity, Ego Boost: cannot retreat or heal; if anyone had gone to therapy, thousands alive.
spokenText: Toxic Masculinity, Ego Boost: cannot retreat or heal; if anyone had gone to therapy, thousands alive.

card.name: Plot Armor
card.power: Narrative Necessity: You cannot die until act 5.
card.lore: Why didn't they shoot him earlier? Because the script said no.

line: Plot Armor, Narrative Necessity: cannot die until act 5; script said no.
spokenText: Plot Armor, Narrative Necessity: cannot die until act 5; script said no.

card.name: Germanic Depression
card.power: Weltschmerz: All players lose 1 morale token.
card.lore: It's not about winning. It's about enduring the inevitable doom with a stoic face.

line: Germanic Depression, Weltschmerz: enduring inevitable doom with stoic face.
spokenText: I used to believe Germanic Depression, Weltschmerz: enduring inevitable doom with stoic face.

card.name: The McGuffin
card.power: Wildcard: Assign any value to this card.
card.lore: Is it the Gold? The Ring? The Belt? Doesn't matter. It's just the thing that makes people kill each other.

line: The McGuffin, Wildcard: any value; gold, ring, belt, people kill each other.
spokenText: The McGuffin, Wildcard: any value; gold, ring, belt, people kill each other.
